title: One Purchased Contract per Unit: Harbison Protection Contracts Terms
content:
**Condition 1. One purchased contract at a time.** A unit may be covered by only one purchased protection contract in pending or active status at a time. A matched-system contract counts against both of its units. The purchased tiers are the Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection, the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection, the Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection and the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus.

**Condition 2. The included workmanship warranty runs alongside.** The included Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty does not count toward this limit and runs alongside a purchased contract on the same unit.

**Condition 3. Which contract a claim is filed against.** When both the workmanship warranty and a purchased contract are active on the failed unit, a claim for installation workmanship or the line set is filed against the workmanship warranty, and a claim for every other component is filed against the purchased contract. When the workmanship warranty has ended, installation workmanship and line set claims go to the purchased contract only if that tier covers them.

**Condition 4. Moving to a higher tier.** A buyer who wants a higher tier on a unit that already carries a purchased contract must cancel the existing contract first.

**Evidence.** The test in Condition 1 is read from the company's contract records for the unit: the unit named on each contract (and the paired unit of a matched-system contract), the contract's status and its tier. A customer's statement that a unit is uncovered does not replace those records.

**Filing table for a failed unit (from Condition 3).**

| Workmanship warranty on the unit | Purchased contract on the unit | Failed component | Filed against |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | active | installation workmanship or line set | the workmanship warranty |
| active | active | any other component | the purchased contract |
| ended | active | installation workmanship or line set | the purchased contract, only if its tier covers the component |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**

- A unit carries an active Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection. A second purchased contract on that unit, in any tier, would breach Condition 1.
- A unit is the outdoor half of a matched system covered by a pending Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection. That contract already counts against the unit.
- A unit carries only the Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty. Condition 1 is not reached, because the workmanship warranty does not count.
